1module micro_mg_cam
2
3!---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4!
5! CAM Interfaces for MG microphysics
6!
7!---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8!
9! How to add new packed MG inputs to micro_mg_cam_tend:
10!
11! If you have an input with first dimension [psetcols, pver], the procedure
12! for adding inputs is as follows:
13!
14! 1) In addition to any variables you need to declare for the "unpacked"
15! (CAM format) version, you must declare an allocatable or pointer array
16! for the "packed" (MG format) version.
17!
18! 2) After micro_mg_get_cols is called, allocate the "packed" array with
19! size [mgncol, nlev].
20!
21! 3) Add a call similar to the following line (look before the
22! micro_mg_tend calls to see similar lines):
23!
24! packed_array = packer%pack(original_array)
25!
26! The packed array can then be passed into any of the MG schemes.
27!
28! This same procedure will also work for 1D arrays of size psetcols, 3-D
29! arrays with psetcols and pver as the first dimensions, and for arrays of
30! dimension [psetcols, pverp]. You only have to modify the allocation of
31! the packed array before the "pack" call.
32!
33!---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
34!
35! How to add new packed MG outputs to micro_mg_cam_tend:
36!
37! 1) As with inputs, in addition to the unpacked outputs you must declare
38! an allocatable or pointer array for packed data. The unpacked and
39! packed arrays must *also* be targets or pointers (but cannot be both).
40!
41! 2) Again as for inputs, allocate the packed array using mgncol and nlev,
42! which are set in micro_mg_get_cols.
43!
44! 3) Add the field to post-processing as in the following line (again,
45! there are many examples before the micro_mg_tend calls):
46!
47! call post_proc%add_field(p(final_array),p(packed_array))
48!
49! This registers the field for post-MG averaging, and to scatter to the
50! final, unpacked version of the array.
51!
52! By default, any columns/levels that are not operated on by MG will be
53! set to 0 on output; this value can be adjusted using the "fillvalue"
54! optional argument to post_proc%add_field.
55!
56! Also by default, outputs from multiple substeps will be averaged after
57! MG's substepping is complete. Passing the optional argument
58! "accum_method=accum_null" will change this behavior so that the last
59! substep is always output.
60!
61! This procedure works on 1-D and 2-D outputs. Note that the final,
62! unpacked arrays are not set until the call to
63! "post_proc%process_and_unpack", which sets every single field that was
64! added with post_proc%add_field.
65!
66!---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

241512512subroutine micro_mg_cam_readnl(nlfile)
242
243 use namelist_utils, only: find_group_name
244 use units, only: getunit, freeunit
245 use mpishorthand
246
247 character(len=*), intent(in) :: nlfile ! filepath for file containing namelist input
248
249 ! Namelist variables
250 logical :: micro_mg_do_cldice = .true. ! do_cldice = .true., MG microphysics is prognosing cldice
251 logical :: micro_mg_do_cldliq = .true. ! do_cldliq = .true., MG microphysics is prognosing cldliq
252 integer :: micro_mg_num_steps = 1 ! Number of substepping iterations done by MG (1.5 only for now).
253
254
255 ! Local variables
256 integer :: unitn, ierr
257 character(len=*), parameter :: subname = 'micro_mg_cam_readnl'
258
25911 namelist /micro_mg_nl/ micro_mg_version, micro_mg_sub_version, &
260 micro_mg_do_cldice, micro_mg_do_cldliq, micro_mg_num_steps, &
261 microp_uniform, micro_mg_dcs, micro_mg_precip_frac_method, micro_mg_berg_eff_factor
262
263 !-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
264
265512512 if (masterproc) then
26612 unitn = getunit()
26715 open( unitn, file=trim(nlfile), status='old' )
26811 call find_group_name(unitn, 'micro_mg_nl', status=ierr)
26911 if (ierr == 0) then
27013 read(unitn, micro_mg_nl, iostat=ierr)
271 if (ierr /= 0) then
27200 call endrun(subname // ':: ERROR reading namelist')
273 end if
274 end if
27512 close(unitn)
27611 call freeunit(unitn)
277
278 ! set local variables
27911 do_cldice = micro_mg_do_cldice
280 do_cldliq = micro_mg_do_cldliq
281 num_steps = micro_mg_num_steps
282
283 ! Verify that version numbers are valid.
284 select case (micro_mg_version)
285 case (1)
28611 select case (micro_mg_sub_version)
287 case(0)
288 ! MG version 1.0
289 case(5)
290 ! MG version 1.5 - MG2 development
291 case default
29200 call bad_version_endrun()
293 end select
294 case (2)
29500 select case (micro_mg_sub_version)
296 case(0)
297 ! MG version 2.0
298 case default
29900 call bad_version_endrun()
300 end select
301 case default
30200 call bad_version_endrun()
303 end select
304
30511 if (micro_mg_dcs < 0._r8) call endrun( "micro_mg_cam_readnl: &
306 &micro_mg_dcs has not been set to a valid value.")
307 end if
308
309#ifdef SPMD
310 ! Broadcast namelist variables
311512512 call mpibcast(micro_mg_version, 1, mpiint, 0, mpicom)
312512512 call mpibcast(micro_mg_sub_version, 1, mpiint, 0, mpicom)
313512512 call mpibcast(do_cldice, 1, mpilog, 0, mpicom)
314512512 call mpibcast(do_cldliq, 1, mpilog, 0, mpicom)
315512512 call mpibcast(num_steps, 1, mpiint, 0, mpicom)
316512512 call mpibcast(microp_uniform, 1, mpilog, 0, mpicom)
317512512 call mpibcast(micro_mg_dcs, 1, mpir8, 0, mpicom)
318512512 call mpibcast(micro_mg_berg_eff_factor, 1, mpir8, 0, mpicom)
319512512 call mpibcast(micro_mg_precip_frac_method, 16, mpichar,0, mpicom)
320
321#endif
322
323512512contains
324
325 subroutine bad_version_endrun
326 ! Endrun wrapper with a more useful error message.
327 character(len=128) :: errstring
328 write(errstring,*) "Invalid version number specified for MG microphysics: ", &
329 micro_mg_version,".",micro_mg_sub_version
330 call endrun(errstring)
331 end subroutine bad_version_endrun
332
333end subroutine micro_mg_cam_readnl

337512512subroutine micro_mg_cam_register
338
339 ! Register microphysics constituents and fields in the physics buffer.
340 !-----------------------------------------------------------------------
341
342 logical :: prog_modal_aero
343 logical :: use_subcol_microp ! If true, then are using subcolumns in microphysics
344
345512512 call phys_getopts(use_subcol_microp_out = use_subcol_microp, &
346 prog_modal_aero_out = prog_modal_aero)
347
348 ! Register microphysics constituents and save indices.
349
350512512 call cnst_add(cnst_names(1), mwh2o, cpair, 0._r8, ixcldliq, &
351 longname='Grid box averaged cloud liquid amount', is_convtran1=.true.)
352512512 call cnst_add(cnst_names(2), mwh2o, cpair, 0._r8, ixcldice, &
353 longname='Grid box averaged cloud ice amount', is_convtran1=.true.)
354
355 ! The next statements should have "is_convtran1=.true.", but this would change
356 ! answers for MG 1.0. Thus make an exception for that version only.
3575121024 if (micro_mg_version == 1 .and. micro_mg_sub_version == 0) then
358512512 call cnst_add(cnst_names(3), mwh2o, cpair, 0._r8, ixnumliq, &
359 longname='Grid box averaged cloud liquid number', is_convtran1=.false.)
360512512 call cnst_add(cnst_names(4), mwh2o, cpair, 0._r8, ixnumice, &
361 longname='Grid box averaged cloud ice number', is_convtran1=.false.)
362 else
36300 call cnst_add(cnst_names(3), mwh2o, cpair, 0._r8, ixnumliq, &
364 longname='Grid box averaged cloud liquid number', is_convtran1=.true.)
36500 call cnst_add(cnst_names(4), mwh2o, cpair, 0._r8, ixnumice, &
366 longname='Grid box averaged cloud ice number', is_convtran1=.true.)
367 end if
368
369 ! Note is_convtran1 is set to .true.
370512512 if (micro_mg_version > 1) then
37100 call cnst_add(cnst_names(5), mwh2o, cpair, 0._r8, ixrain, &
372 longname='Grid box averaged rain amount', is_convtran1=.true.)
37300 call cnst_add(cnst_names(6), mwh2o, cpair, 0._r8, ixsnow, &
374 longname='Grid box averaged snow amount', is_convtran1=.true.)
37500 call cnst_add(cnst_names(7), mwh2o, cpair, 0._r8, ixnumrain, &

50300 call pbuf_register_subcol('LS_REFFSNOW', 'micro_mg_cam_register', ls_reffsnow_idx)
50400 call pbuf_register_subcol('CV_REFFLIQ', 'micro_mg_cam_register', cv_reffliq_idx)
50500 call pbuf_register_subcol('CV_REFFICE', 'micro_mg_cam_register', cv_reffice_idx)
506 end if
507
508 ! Additional pbuf for CARMA interface
509512512 if (.not. do_cldice) then
51000 call pbuf_add_field('TND_QSNOW', 'physpkg',dtype_r8,(/pcols,pver/), tnd_qsnow_idx)
51100 call pbuf_add_field('TND_NSNOW', 'physpkg',dtype_r8,(/pcols,pver/), tnd_nsnow_idx)
51200 call pbuf_add_field('RE_ICE', 'physpkg',dtype_r8,(/pcols,pver/), re_ice_idx)
513 end if
514
515 ! Precipitation efficiency fields across timesteps.
5165122048 call pbuf_add_field('ACPRECL', 'global',dtype_r8,(/pcols/), acpr_idx) ! accumulated precip
5175122048 call pbuf_add_field('ACGCME', 'global',dtype_r8,(/pcols/), acgcme_idx) ! accumulated condensation
5185122048 call pbuf_add_field('ACNUM', 'global',dtype_i4,(/pcols/), acnum_idx) ! counter for accumulated # timesteps
519
520 ! SGS variability -- These could be reset by CLUBB so they need to be grid only
5215121024 call pbuf_add_field('RELVAR', 'global',dtype_r8,(/pcols,pver/), relvar_idx)
5225121024 call pbuf_add_field('ACCRE_ENHAN','global',dtype_r8,(/pcols,pver/), accre_enhan_idx)
523
524 ! Diagnostic fields needed for subcol_SILHS, need to be grid-only
5255121024 if (subcol_get_scheme() == 'SILHS') then
52600 call pbuf_add_field('QRAIN', 'global',dtype_r8,(/pcols,pver/), qrain_idx)
52700 call pbuf_add_field('QSNOW', 'global',dtype_r8,(/pcols,pver/), qsnow_idx)
52800 call pbuf_add_field('NRAIN', 'global',dtype_r8,(/pcols,pver/), nrain_idx)
52900 call pbuf_add_field('NSNOW', 'global',dtype_r8,(/pcols,pver/), nsnow_idx)
530 end if
531
532512512end subroutine micro_mg_cam_register

5361638416384function micro_mg_cam_implements_cnst(name)
537
538 ! Return true if specified constituent is implemented by the
539 ! microphysics package
540
541 character(len=*), intent(in) :: name ! constituent name

546131072442368 micro_mg_cam_implements_cnst = any(name == cnst_names)

552subroutine micro_mg_cam_init_cnst(name, q, gcid)
553

568512512subroutine micro_mg_cam_init(pbuf2d)
569 use time_manager, only: is_first_step
570 use micro_mg_utils, only: micro_mg_utils_init

572 use micro_mg1_5, only: micro_mg_init1_5 => micro_mg_init
573 use micro_mg2_0, only: micro_mg_init2_0 => micro_mg_init
574
575 !-----------------------------------------------------------------------
576 !
577 ! Initialization for MG microphysics
578 !
579 !-----------------------------------------------------------------------
580
581 type(physics_buffer_desc), pointer :: pbuf2d(:,:)
582
583 integer :: m, mm
584 logical :: history_amwg ! output the variables used by the AMWG diag package
585 logical :: history_budget ! Output tendencies and state variables for CAM4
586 ! temperature, water vapor, cloud ice and cloud
587 ! liquid budgets.
588 logical :: use_subcol_microp
589 integer :: budget_histfile ! output history file number for budget fields
590 integer :: ierr
591 character(128) :: errstring ! return status (non-blank for error return)
592
593 !-----------------------------------------------------------------------
594
595512512 call phys_getopts(use_subcol_microp_out=use_subcol_microp)
596
597512512 if (masterproc) then
59815 write(iulog,"(A,I2,A,I2)") "Initializing MG version ",micro_mg_version,".",micro_mg_sub_version
59911 if (.not. do_cldliq) &
60000 write(iulog,*) "MG prognostic cloud liquid has been turned off via namelist."
60111 if (.not. do_cldice) &
60200 write(iulog,*) "MG prognostic cloud ice has been turned off via namelist."
60313 write(iulog,*) "Number of microphysics substeps is: ",num_steps
604 end if
605
606512512 select case (micro_mg_version)
607 case (1)
608 ! Set constituent number for later loops.
609512512 ncnst = 4
610
611 select case (micro_mg_sub_version)
612 case (0)
613 ! MG 1 does not initialize micro_mg_utils, so have to do it here.
614512512 call micro_mg_utils_init(r8, rh2o, cpair, tmelt, latvap, latice, &
615 micro_mg_dcs, errstring)
616512512 call handle_errmsg(errstring, subname="micro_mg_utils_init")
617
618512512 call micro_mg_init1_0( &
619 r8, gravit, rair, rh2o, cpair, &
620 rhoh2o, tmelt, latvap, latice, &
621 rhmini, micro_mg_dcs, use_hetfrz_classnuc, &
622 micro_mg_precip_frac_method, micro_mg_berg_eff_factor, errstring)
623 case (5)
624 ! MG 1 does not initialize micro_mg_utils, so have to do it here.
62500 call micro_mg_utils_init(r8, rh2o, cpair, tmelt, latvap, latice, &
626 micro_mg_dcs, errstring)
62700 call handle_errmsg(errstring, subname="micro_mg_utils_init")
628
62900 call micro_mg_init1_5( &
630 r8, gravit, rair, rh2o, cpair, &
631 tmelt, latvap, latice, rhmini, &
632 micro_mg_dcs, &
633 microp_uniform, do_cldice, use_hetfrz_classnuc, &
634 micro_mg_precip_frac_method, micro_mg_berg_eff_factor, errstring)
635 end select
636 case (2)
637 ! Set constituent number for later loops.
63800 ncnst = 8
639
640 select case (micro_mg_sub_version)
641 case (0)
64200 call micro_mg_init2_0( &
643 r8, gravit, rair, rh2o, cpair, &
644 tmelt, latvap, latice, rhmini, &
645 micro_mg_dcs, &
646 microp_uniform, do_cldice, use_hetfrz_classnuc, &
647 micro_mg_precip_frac_method, micro_mg_berg_eff_factor, errstring)
648 end select
649 end select
650
651512512 call handle_errmsg(errstring, subname="micro_mg_init")
652
653 ! Register history variables
65420482560 do m = 1, ncnst
65520482048 call cnst_get_ind(cnst_names(m), mm)
656819230720 if ( any(mm == (/ ixcldliq, ixcldice, ixrain, ixsnow /)) ) then
657 ! mass mixing ratios
65810241024 call addfld(cnst_name(mm), 'kg/kg ', pver, 'A', cnst_longname(mm) , phys_decomp)
65910246144 call addfld(sflxnam(mm), 'kg/m2/s ', 1, 'A', trim(cnst_name(mm))//' surface flux', phys_decomp)
660409615360 else if ( any(mm == (/ ixnumliq, ixnumice, ixnumrain, ixnumsnow /)) ) then
661 ! number concentrations
66210241024 call addfld(cnst_name(mm), '1/kg ', pver, 'A', cnst_longname(mm) , phys_decomp)
66310246144 call addfld(sflxnam(mm), '1/m2/s ', 1, 'A', trim(cnst_name(mm))//' surface flux', phys_decomp)
664 else
66500 call endrun( "micro_mg_cam_init: &
666 &Could not call addfld for constituent with unknown units.")
667 endif

669
6705123072 call addfld(apcnst(ixcldliq), 'kg/kg ', pver, 'A', trim(cnst_name(ixcldliq))//' after physics' , phys_decomp)
6715122560 call addfld(apcnst(ixcldice), 'kg/kg ', pver, 'A', trim(cnst_name(ixcldice))//' after physics' , phys_decomp)

67700 call addfld(apcnst(ixsnow), 'kg/kg ', pver, 'A', trim(cnst_name(ixsnow))//' after physics' , phys_decomp)

23152156856052988000 CC_T(:ncol,top_lev:pver) = tlat(:ncol,top_lev:pver)/cpair
23162156856052988000 CC_qv(:ncol,top_lev:pver) = qvlat(:ncol,top_lev:pver)

23192156856052988000 CC_nl(:ncol,top_lev:pver) = ncten(:ncol,top_lev:pver)
23202156856052988000 CC_ni(:ncol,top_lev:pver) = niten(:ncol,top_lev:pver)

23242156856052988000 qme(:ncol,top_lev:pver) = cmeliq(:ncol,top_lev:pver) + cmeiout(:ncol,top_lev:pver)
2325

2329 ! array and need to avoid an FPE due to uninitialized data.
23308519681970176 prec_pcw = prect
23318519681970176 snow_pcw = preci
2332851968958464 prec_sed = 0._r8
2333851968958464 snow_sed = 0._r8

2340 ! ------------------------------------------------------------ !
2341 ! Compute in cloud ice and liquid mixing ratios !
2342 ! Note that 'iclwp, iciwp' are used for radiation computation. !
2343 ! ------------------------------------------------------------ !
2344
23452555904030457856 icinc = 0._r8
23462555904030457856 icwnc = 0._r8
23472555904030457856 iciwpst = 0._r8
23482555904030457856 iclwpst = 0._r8
23492555904030457856 icswp = 0._r8
23502555904030457856 cldfsnow = 0._r8

235215974401650688 do k = top_lev, pver
23532156856023166000 do i = 1, ncol
2354 ! Limits for in-cloud mixing ratios consistent with MG microphysics
2355 ! in-cloud mixing ratio maximum limit of 0.005 kg/kg
23562156856021568560 icimrst(i,k) = min( state_loc%q(i,k,ixcldice) / max(mincld,icecldf(i,k)),0.005_r8 )
2357 icwmrst(i,k) = min( state_loc%q(i,k,ixcldliq) / max(mincld,liqcldf(i,k)),0.005_r8 )
2358 icinc(i,k) = state_loc%q(i,k,ixnumice) / max(mincld,icecldf(i,k)) * &
2359 state_loc%pmid(i,k) / (287.15_r8*state_loc%t(i,k))
2360 icwnc(i,k) = state_loc%q(i,k,ixnumliq) / max(mincld,liqcldf(i,k)) * &
2361 state_loc%pmid(i,k) / (287.15_r8*state_loc%t(i,k))
2362 ! Calculate micro_mg_cam cloud water paths in each layer
2363 ! Note: uses stratiform cloud fraction!
2364 iciwpst(i,k) = min(state_loc%q(i,k,ixcldice)/max(mincld,ast(i,k)),0.005_r8) * state_loc%pdel(i,k) / gravit
2365 iclwpst(i,k) = min(state_loc%q(i,k,ixcldliq)/max(mincld,ast(i,k)),0.005_r8) * state_loc%pdel(i,k) / gravit
2366
2367 ! ------------------------------ !
2368 ! Adjust cloud fraction for snow !
2369 ! ------------------------------ !
2370 cldfsnow(i,k) = cld(i,k)
2371 ! If cloud and only ice ( no convective cloud or ice ), then set to 0.
2372720705011397001 if( ( cldfsnow(i,k) .gt. 1.e-4_r8 ) .and. &
2373 ( concld(i,k) .lt. 1.e-4_r8 ) .and. &
2374 ( state_loc%q(i,k,ixcldliq) .lt. 1.e-10_r8 ) ) then
237530789753078975 cldfsnow(i,k) = 0._r8
2376 end if
2377 ! If no cloud and snow, then set to 0.25
23782156856039009045 if( ( cldfsnow(i,k) .le. 1.e-4_r8 ) .and. ( qsout(i,k) .gt. 1.e-6_r8 ) ) then
237911752821175282 cldfsnow(i,k) = 0.25_r8
2380 end if
2381 ! Calculate in-cloud snow water path
2382 icswp(i,k) = qsout(i,k) / max( mincld, cldfsnow(i,k) ) * state_loc%pdel(i,k) / gravit
2383 end do

2724

27272156856048035936 call size_dist_param_liq(mg_liq_props, icwmrst_grid(:ngrdcol,top_lev:), &

27392555904030457856 mu_grid = 0._r8

275121568560208760240 where (icwmrst_grid(:ngrdcol,top_lev:) >= qsmall)

27622555904030404608 drout2_grid = 0._r8

27642555904030457856 des_grid = 0._r8
27652555904030457856 dsout2_grid = 0._r8
27662555904030457856 reff_snow_grid = 0._r8
2767
27685324853248 if (micro_mg_version > 1) then

277100 where (qr_grid(:ngrdcol,top_lev:) >= 1.e-7_r8)

2773 qr_grid(:ngrdcol,top_lev:), &

2794 else

279721568560162374992 where (qrout_grid(:ngrdcol,top_lev:) >= 1.e-7_r8)
279817054433356131 drout2_grid(:ngrdcol,top_lev:) = avg_diameter( &
2799 qrout_grid(:ngrdcol,top_lev:), &
2800 nrout_grid(:ngrdcol,top_lev:) * rho_grid(:ngrdcol,top_lev:), &
2801 rho_grid(:ngrdcol,top_lev:), rhow)
2802
280317054433462627 reff_rain_grid(:ngrdcol,top_lev:) = drout2_grid(:ngrdcol,top_lev:) * &

2805 end where
2806
280721568560208760240 where (qsout_grid(:ngrdcol,top_lev:) >= 1.e-7_r8)

281324705984121286 des_grid(:ngrdcol,top_lev:) = dsout2_grid(:ngrdcol,top_lev:) &

2818 end where

2820 end if

284115974401597440 do k = top_lev, pver
28422156856023166000 do i = 1, ngrdcol

28442156856021568560 des_grid(i,k) = des_grid(i,k) * 1.e6_r8
2845 if ( ast_grid(i,k) < 1.e-4_r8 ) then
28461450395414503954 mu_grid(i,k) = mucon
2847 lambdac_grid(i,k) = (mucon + 1._r8)/dcon
2848 dei_grid(i,k) = deicon

2850 end do
2851 end do

28532156856026467376 mgreffrain_grid(:ngrdcol,top_lev:pver) = reff_rain_grid(:ngrdcol,top_lev:pver)
28542156856026467376 mgreffsnow_grid(:ngrdcol,top_lev:pver) = reff_snow_grid(:ngrdcol,top_lev:pver)

2856 ! ------------------------------------- !
2857 ! Precipitation efficiency Calculation !
2858 ! ------------------------------------- !
2859
2860 !-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2861 ! Liquid water path
2862
2863 ! Compute liquid water paths, and column condensation
2864718952825448 tgliqwp_grid(:ngrdcol) = 0._r8
2865718952825448 tgcmeliq_grid(:ngrdcol) = 0._r8
286615974401650688 do k = top_lev, pver
28672156856023166000 do i = 1, ngrdcol
28682156856021568560 tgliqwp_grid(i) = tgliqwp_grid(i) + iclwpst_grid(i,k)*cld_grid(i,k)
2869
2870 if (cmeliq_grid(i,k) > 1.e-12_r8) then
2871 !convert cmeliq to right units: kgh2o/kgair/s * kgair/m2 / kgh2o/m3 = m/s
287218714551871455 tgcmeliq_grid(i) = tgcmeliq_grid(i) + cmeliq_grid(i,k) * &
2873 (pdel_grid(i,k) / gravit) / rhoh2o
2874 end if
2875 end do
2876 end do
2877
2878 ! note: 1e-6 kgho2/kgair/s * 1000. pa / (9.81 m/s2) / 1000 kgh2o/m3 = 1e-7 m/s
2879 ! this is 1ppmv of h2o in 10hpa
2880 ! alternatively: 0.1 mm/day * 1.e-4 m/mm * 1/86400 day/s = 1.e-9
2881
2882 !-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2883 ! precipitation efficiency calculation (accumulate cme and precip)
2884
28855324853248 minlwp = 0.01_r8 !minimum lwp threshold (kg/m3)
2886
2887 ! zero out precip efficiency and total averaged precip
2888718952825448 pe_grid(:ngrdcol) = 0._r8
2889718952825448 tpr_grid(:ngrdcol) = 0._r8
2890718952825448 pefrac_grid(:ngrdcol) = 0._r8
2891
2892 ! accumulate precip and condensation
2893718952772200 do i = 1, ngrdcol
2894
2895718952718952 acgcme_grid(i) = acgcme_grid(i) + tgcmeliq_grid(i)
2896 acprecl_grid(i) = acprecl_grid(i) + prec_str_grid(i)
2897 acnum_grid(i) = acnum_grid(i) + 1
2898
2899 ! if LWP is zero, then 'end of cloud': calculate precip efficiency
2900 if (tgliqwp_grid(i) < minlwp) then
2901363593363593 if (acprecl_grid(i) > 5.e-8_r8) then
29021380713807 tpr_grid(i) = max(acprecl_grid(i)/acnum_grid(i), 1.e-15_r8)
2903 if (acgcme_grid(i) > 1.e-10_r8) then
29041344013440 pe_grid(i) = min(max(acprecl_grid(i)/acgcme_grid(i), 1.e-15_r8), 1.e5_r8)
2905 pefrac_grid(i) = 1._r8
2906 end if
2907 end if
2908
2909 ! reset counters
2910! if (pe_grid(i) /= 0._r8 .and. (pe_grid(i) < 1.e-8_r8 .or. pe_grid(i) > 1.e3_r8)) then
2911! write (iulog,*) 'PE_grid:ANOMALY pe_grid, acprecl_grid, acgcme_grid, tpr_grid, acnum_grid ', &
2912! pe_grid(i),acprecl_grid(i), acgcme_grid(i), tpr_grid(i), acnum_grid(i)
2913! endif
2914
2915363593363593 acprecl_grid(i) = 0._r8
2916 acgcme_grid(i) = 0._r8
2917 acnum_grid(i) = 0
2918 end if ! end LWP zero conditional
2919
2920 ! if never find any rain....(after 10^3 timesteps...)
2921718952718952 if (acnum_grid(i) > 1000) then
292200 acnum_grid(i) = 0
2923 acprecl_grid(i) = 0._r8
2924 acgcme_grid(i) = 0._r8
2925 end if
2926
2927 end do

29372156856092837376 where (prao_grid(:ngrdcol,k) /= 0._r8) cnt_grid(:ngrdcol) = cnt_grid(:ngrdcol) + 1
2938 end do
2939
29408519684136290 where (cnt_grid > 0) vprao_grid = vprao_grid/cnt_grid
2941
2942851968958464 vprco_grid = 0._r8
2943851968958464 cnt_grid = 0
294415974401650688 do k = top_lev, pver
29452156856024763440 vprco_grid(:ngrdcol) = vprco_grid(:ngrdcol) + prco_grid(:ngrdcol,k)
29462156856092998181 where (prco_grid(:ngrdcol,k) /= 0._r8) cnt_grid(:ngrdcol) = cnt_grid(:ngrdcol) + 1
2947 end do
2948
29498519682662400 where (cnt_grid > 0)
29508519682432355 vprco_grid = vprco_grid/cnt_grid

2952 elsewhere
29538519682040477 racau_grid = 0._r8

2997851968958464 ctrei_grid = 0._r8
2998851968958464 ctnl_grid = 0._r8
2999851968958464 ctni_grid = 0._r8
3000718952772200 do i = 1, ngrdcol
30011366851614387468 do k = top_lev, pver
30021430703815458868 if ( liqcldf_grid(i,k) > 0.01_r8 .and. icwmrst_grid(i,k) > 1.e-7_r8 ) then

3056 + msacwio_grid(:ngrdcol,top_lev:pver)
